description: This Java class, ConceptEditor, extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to handle serialization and deserialization of Concept objects, including retrieval by ID and UUID, to facilitate form data handling in the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ConceptEditor
classes.description: A Spring property editor for the Concept class, enabling conversion between Concept objects and their string representations (by ID or UUID).

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Concept object by its numeric ID using the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Concept object by its UUID using the ConceptService.
